adminOutreach.title: Outreach
adminOutreach.body: Companies you email about WemustE. Each one gets its own private video link: only they can open it, and you see when they do.
adminOutreach.step1: Add the companies below (paste from a spreadsheet or open a CSV file).
adminOutreach.step2: On a company, press “Copy address”, then “Copy subject”, and paste them into a new email in your mailbox.
adminOutreach.step3: Press “Copy email” and paste it into the email body, then send it.
adminOutreach.step4: Back here, press “Mark as sent”. You'll see when they open their link and when they ask to become a sponsor.

adminOutreach.pasteLabel: One company per line: Name, Company, Email, Country (country is optional)
